configuration.cwtools.trace.server.descr: Traces the communication between VSCode and the language server.
configuration.cwtools.editor.formatInden: Auto-adjust the indentation of pasted PDX code blocks to match the surrounding brace nesting.
configuration.cwtools.localisation.langu: The list of languages to validate localisation for.
configuration.cwtools.localisation.gener: The placeholder string used when generating missing localisation strings.
configuration.cwtools.errors.vanilla.des: Whether or not to show errors for vanilla files
configuration.cwtools.errors.ignore.desc: Error codes to ignore, list of IDs
configuration.cwtools.errors.ignorefiles: Files to ignore errors from, list of file names
configuration.cwtools.experimental.descr: Whether or not to enable experimental features
configuration.cwtools.debug_mode.descrip: Debug features for helping write rules
configuration.cwtools.logging.diagnostic: Whether to output diagnostic level logs
configuration.cwtools.rules_version.desc: Which version of rules to auto-update to. Manual will use the local path set in rules_folder
configuration.cwtools.rules_folder.descr: A folder containing custom rules to use
configuration.cwtools.ignore_patterns.de: File paths to ignore (not load into cwtools), list of glob patterns
configuration.cwtools.cache.eu4.descript: The location of a vanilla EU4 installation
configuration.cwtools.cache.hoi4.descrip: The location of a vanilla HOI4 installation
configuration.cwtools.cache.stellaris.de: The location of a vanilla Stellaris installation
configuration.cwtools.cache.ck2.descript: The location of a vanilla CK2 installation
configuration.cwtools.cache.imperator.de: The location of a vanilla I:R installation
configuration.cwtools.cache.vic2.descrip: The location of a vanilla VIC2 installation
configuration.cwtools.cache.ck3.descript: The location of a vanilla CK3 installation
configuration.cwtools.cache.vic3.descrip: The location of a vanilla VIC3 installation
configuration.cwtools.cache.eu5.descript: The location of a vanilla EU5 installation
configuration.cwtools.scriptedVariablesF: Additional paths to search for scripted_variables files (for hover tooltips and completions). Add paths to vanilla or mod scripted_variables folders.
configuration.cwtools.graph.zoomSensitiv: Control scroll wheel zoom sensitivity, <1 reduces sensitivity, >1 increases sensitivity
configuration.cwtools.maxFileSize.descri: Maximum script file size to load in megabytes (warning, very large files can cause instability or invalid diagnostics)
configuration.cwtools.diagnostics.deferD: Defer publishing dynamic-parameter diagnostics (inline_script expansions, scripted effect/trigger/value parameter substitution) on first load, then revalidate affected files once data has warmed up. Reduces phantom errors that vanish once a file is opened.
configuration.cwtools.diagnostics.dynami: Time budget (ms) for warming dynamic-parameter computed data (scripted effects/triggers, script values, inline scripts) before the first validation pass. 0 means no time limit.
Maximum number of dynamic-parameter entities to warm before the first validation pass. 0 means no limit.
configuration.cwtools.checkForUpdates.de: Enable automatic checking for extension updates via GitHub Releases.
configuration.cwtools.ai.enabled.descrip: Enable AI-assisted code generation and completion
configuration.cwtools.ai.provider.descri: AI Provider. API Keys: [OpenAI](https://platform.openai.com/api-keys) | [Claude](https://console.anthropic.com/) | [DeepSeek](https://platform.deepseek.com/) | [MiniMax](https://minimaxi.com/) | [Zhipu](https://bigmodel.cn/) | [Qwen](https://dashscope.console.aliyun.com/) | [SiliconFlow](https://cloud.siliconflow.cn/) | [OpenRouter](https://openrouter.ai/keys) | [GitHub](https://github.com/marketplace/models) | [Together AI](https://api.together.xyz/) | [DeepInfra](https://deepinfra.com/dash/api_keys) | [Kimi](https://platform.moonshot.cn/) | Custom OpenAI-compatible endpoint
configuration.cwtools.ai.model.descripti: AI model name (leave empty for provider default)
configuration.cwtools.ai.endpoint.descri: Legacy single API endpoint (migrated to per-provider endpoints automatically). Prefer cwtools.ai.providerEndpoints.
configuration.cwtools.ai.providerEndpoin: Per-provider API endpoint overrides, keyed by provider id (e.g. "custom", "ollama"). Each provider keeps its own endpoint so switching providers no longer leaks endpoints between them.
configuration.cwtools.ai.customApiFormat: Wire protocol used by the custom provider.
configuration.cwtools.ai.agentFileWriteM: Show diff confirmation before writing (Default, Safe)
Agent file write mode: confirm=Show diff before saving, auto=Direct save
configuration.cwtools.ai.maxRetries.desc: Maximum validation-retry rounds for generated code
configuration.cwtools.ai.requestTimeoutM: Maximum wall-clock time for a single AI chat completion request in milliseconds. The default is 20 minutes.
configuration.cwtools.ai.maxContextToken: Override max context window size (tokens). 0 = use provider default. Useful for Ollama or custom providers.
configuration.cwtools.ai.inlineCompletio: Delay before triggering inline AI completion (ms)
Maximum tokens generated by one inline FIM completion request.
Number of lines before the cursor to include in inline FIM context.
Number of lines after the cursor to include in inline FIM context.
Include MCP resource context in inline completion requests. Disabled by default for latency and quality.
TTL for cached MCP context used by inline completion (ms).
Hard timeout for one inline FIM completion request (ms).
Use fast local/LSP inline completion before sending an AI FIM request.
Enable automatic detection and trimming of overlapping suffix code to prevent duplication.
Provider for inline completion (leave empty to use main provider)
Model for inline completion (can differ from chat model, e.g. use a faster model)
Custom endpoint for inline completion provider (leave empty to use provider default)

configuration.cwtools.showInlineText.des: Show localisation and references directly above the code instead of hovering.
configuration.cwtools.ai.reasoningEffort: Thinking depth / Reasoning effort for supported AI models (DeepSeek, OpenAI o-series).
configuration.cwtools.ai.dynamicModelsCo: Dynamically fetched AI models context sizes
configuration.cwtools.ai.developer.disab: WARNING: Disables all AI file path constraints and shell command blocklists. Extremely dangerous, use at your own risk!
commands.cwtools.ai.codeAction.fixAll: AI: Fix all CWTools errors in file
configuration.cwtools.ai.ignoredDiagnost: List of diagnostic keys (e.g. external mod keys) to be completely ignored by the LSP Problems panel and AI Agent. Modifiable via 'Manage Ignored Diagnostics' command.
configuration.cwtools.ai.enhancedDiagnos: Localize validation errors in the Problems panel: when the VS Code display language is Chinese, recognized messages are replaced with a Chinese translation including fix advice; otherwise a 💡 fix-advice line is appended to the English message.
configuration.cwtools.ai.braveSearchApiK: Brave Search API key for web_search tool. Get one at https://brave.com/search/api/
configuration.cwtools.ai.exaApiKey.descr: Exa API key for codesearch tool. Get one at https://exa.ai
configuration.cwtools.ai.mcp.servers.des: MCP (Model Context Protocol) server configurations for extending AI tool capabilities.
configuration.cwtools.ai.orchestrator.ag: Custom model configuration for Orchestrator sub-agents (e.g. explorer, reviewer)
configuration.cwtools.ai.performance.leg: Use the legacy broad AI toolset instead of mode-aware tool filtering.
configuration.cwtools.ai.performance.ful: Inject the full CWTOOLS.md content into Build mode prompts instead of the compact summary.
configuration.cwtools.ai.performance.inc: Include full current-file content for files under 100 lines instead of header plus local context.
